svg.title: Feature interpretation pipeline
svg.desc: For each feature, interpret.py samples recorded activations, an LLM writes a title and description from 20 excerpts, a fresh call checks them on 24 held-out tokens, the LLM writes 6 test pairs from them that the studied model and SAE score, a failing title and description is revised once, and the feature's decoder direction is added at increasing strengths, keeping the strongest that moves next-token predictions by at most 1 nat of KL, to find the tokens it makes more likely. Results go to interpretations.jsonl and the explorer.

g.text: the tokens it fires on most
– 4 of the tokens it sometimes fires on
sees only the title + description and
a text that should fire and a minimal
runs each text to the SAE's layer;
a pair passes if the contrast stays
under half the first text's activation
sees what each test text scored and
adds the decoder direction at the
the strongest under 1 nat is used
